title: Project Origin: The Shattered Crown - Episode 01: The Gilded Throne
hook_thesis: Silph-Macro Consortium issues an ultimatum to World Monarch Ash Ketchum to surrender his Pokémon to cybernetic Helix Chips, triggering a skyscraper window blast and rooftop ambush.
call_to_action: Follow for Episode 2: Black-Ops Protocol dropping tomorrow!

character_bible.Ash Ketchum: 16-year-old anime hero Ash Ketchum, athletic teenager, messy jet-black spiky hair, red-and-white trainer cap, royal-blue vest with white collar and gold trim, dark charcoal compression undershirt, Alolan Z-Ring on right wrist, Mega Keystone on left wrist, double zig-zag cheek marks, resolute brown eyes.
character_bible.Pikachu: Yellow electric mouse Pokémon Pikachu, black-tipped ears, red circular electric cheek sacs sparking with golden electricity, lightning-bolt shaped tail, intense loyal battle expression.

character_bible.Consortium Enforcers: Cybernetic security enforcers in matte-black hydraulic exoskeleton combat armor, non-reflective tactical Kevlar mesh, amber-glowing tactical visors, carrying electromagnetic stun rifles.
